summary.headline: Anthropic nears $900B valuation as Mythos hunts 10,000 bugs
summary.body: Two Anthropic stories pulled in different directions. Project Glasswing reported that Claude Mythos Preview and about 50 partners flagged over 10,000 serious software vulnerabilities in 30 days, including a 27-year-old OpenBSD bug. That shows rising capability but also AI being used to make systems safer, so it lowers Catastrophic Risk, easing Self-Destruction and Reversion. Japan said its government and banks will get Mythos for cyber defence. Meanwhile Anthropic raised over $30B at about a $900B valuation and OpenAI filed confidentially for an IPO, a clear step up in Power Concentration that favours Enslaved God. Zookeeper earned a Breakout badge for its run over the past week. Horizon Balance edged up 0.01 to 0.4.
summary.movers_note: Enslaved God +0.8, from the Anthropic funding round and OpenAI IPO filing (+0.48) plus Glasswing (+0.37); Reversion -0.6 and Self-Destruction -0.6, mainly from Glasswing's bug-hunting (-0.51 and -0.38).
coming_up: Japan's government is due to get access to Claude Mythos later in May

events.title: Project Glasswing: Mythos Preview finds 10,000+ serious vulnerabilities in 30 days
events.summary: Anthropic reported that Claude Mythos Preview and ~50 partners flagged over 10,000 high/critical vulnerabilities (1,094 confirmed high/critical after review), including a 27-year-old OpenBSD bug; Mozilla fixed 271 Firefox flaws.
events.reason: Concrete evidence of frontier offensive-grade cyber capability, used defensively; partner disclosures partly corroborate.

events.title: Japan's government and banks to get access to Claude Mythos for cyber defence
events.summary: Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said Japan's government would get access to Anthropic's Mythos later in May to strengthen cyber defence, alongside a cybersecurity working group with major banks.
events.reason: Allied state access to a restricted cyber-capable model for defence (Kyodo via Japan Today).

events.title: Anthropic closes $30B+ round at ~$900B valuation; OpenAI files confidentially for IPO
events.summary: Anthropic raised over $30B led by Sequoia, Dragoneer, Altimeter and Greenoaks at a ~$900B valuation, and OpenAI confidentially filed for an IPO at a reported ~$852B valuation.
events.reason: Capital concentrating in two frontier labs. Exact day uncertain (reported May 18-29); best-supported ~May 22.
